scripts.build: tsc && vite build && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('docs')) fs.rmSync('docs', {recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync('dist', 'docs', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('dist/assets', 'assets', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/profile.webp', 'profile.webp');"
